artifacts.summary: 6-phase plan extending lint-state-writer-boundary.sh to the Python json.dump channel via a shared predicate library, with test and reproduction-fixture coverage, a companion PreToolUse Bash hook, a prose pointer, and a redeploy plus full-battery final phase.

memory_candidates.content: When a content lint's own detection predicate is extracted into a shared pattern library, and a both-polarity hook test is added that feeds the anti-pattern as synthetic fixture command strings, BOTH new files will trip the lint on their own text. A 'zero new allowlist entries needed' measurement taken against the pre-change tree does not survive the change that creates those files. Plan the inline-reasoned allowlist entry in the same phase that creates each such file, following the existing self-exclusion precedent (a lint and its fixture suite are already on their own allowlist for exactly this reason), rather than discovering the self-trip at gate-run time.
